Surjectivity on the right: orders |Gal(L/K)| = [L:K], |Gal(L/M)| = [L:M], |Gal(M/K)| = [M:K] and [L:K] = [L:M][M:K] force the image to be all of Gal(M/K); the author also notes the direct extension argument via lemma-lift-maps item 2
